proof_attempt_summary: D0 developed the shared-record Gaussian driver, weighted likelihood contacts, geometry estimates, benchmark compact-interior root-n/subsequential results, ancillary smoothing, and supplied-input coverage-error/certified-width reductions. Repeated primary-source audits and mathematical consults could not establish endpoint-product control, uniqueness, whole-sequence/full-class normalization and law, or a stable total observable calibration with vanishing failure. The note discloses both open questions; mathematics passed and all eight cited statements were verified, but the partial package achieved only incremental novelty and was not taken to Lean formalization.
tldr: Counterfactual density differences and log ratios describe distributional effects that mean comparisons can conceal. This note establishes the full two-arm original-record Gaussian CDF driver, data-estimated affine geometry and exponential weights, and benchmark root-n compact-interior rates with subsequential density-weighted likelihood contacts. Its inference theorem is an explicit finite-sample coverage-error reduction for total connected causal contrast intervals, with a deterministic certified-width bound. The unrestricted all-class likelihood limit and feasible singular-process calibration remain open; unconditional asymptotic coverage and stochastically bounded normalized interval length are not established.
gap: The curvature and shrinking-increment arguments in \cite{HamWestlingDoss2024CounterfactualLogConcave} leave fixed affine regions outside their proof mechanism. The linear-region result in \cite{ChenWellner2016LinearTruth} concerns squared loss, whereas the likelihood perturbation is density weighted.
fill: The research target is a weighted contact law derived from the global estimator and a stable original-data Gaussian calibration for pointwise contrast coverage at every fixed law in the displayed benchmark. All-class likelihood stability, feasible calibration, and coverage remain proof obligations.
